caseName: Washington Dredging & Improvement Co. v. Washington
caseNameFull: Washington Dredging & Improvement Company, in Error v. The State of Washington, E. V. Bussell
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Washington.
attorneys: Mr. Hannis Taylor, Mr. W. F. Hays and Mr. Charles E. Shepard for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Alfred Battle, Mr. Bichard A. Ballinger, Mr. George 13. Cole, Mr. E. C. Bindley, Mr. W. V. Tanner, Mr. Jas. B. Metcalf, Mr. Geo. E. DeSteiguer, Mr. Ira Bronson, Mr. Jas. A. Kerr, Mr. Corwin S. Shank, Mr. Louis Henry Legg and Mr. Frank P. Lewis for the defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction'upon the authority of Washington Dredging & Improvement Company v. The State of Washington, E. V. Bussell, 231 U. S. 742, and cases there cited.
